outcome_unopened_label_query.registered_identity: complete exact-phrase Diels-Alder query with Rhea identifier and equation columns
outcome_unopened_label_query.source_record_role: independent reaction-family label and complete selected-identity census

blind_selection_and_comparison_rule.selection: After the query opens, retain every returned Rhea identifier in query order. Join every identifier to the frozen complete Rhea reaction-SMILES surface without an outcome-dependent exclusion.
blind_selection_and_comparison_rule.direction: Evaluate every exact declared reaction direction present for each independently labeled Rhea identity. A direction instantiates addition only when two or more complete source components become one product component; no direction may be chosen by a favorable-only rule.
blind_selection_and_comparison_rule.atom_correspondence: Enumerate every element-preserving exact source-product atom bijection. No imported atom mapping, product name, measured value, fitted score or heuristic survivor may choose the correspondence.
blind_selection_and_comparison_rule.predicted_family: For every independently labeled addition direction, at least one exact bijection retains all atom occurrences, forms exactly two cross-source-component adjacencies, relocates a positive finite number of multiplicity layers while every reduced adjacency retains a base support, and leaves all other held adjacency unchanged.
blind_selection_and_comparison_rule.complete_retention: Preserve every favorable, adverse, absent, malformed, unresolved, reverse-only and no-frozen-vector query row.
postseal_targets: every favorable adverse absent malformed unresolved and reverse-only row

native_arithmetic_boundary: No external numerical zero, signed, decimal, continuum or conventional structure inscription enters native forcing; structural absence is EmptyOne.
